# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue for a suspected security vulnerability. Email security@gazebohq.com with:

- the affected protocol version, package, schema, or validator
- clear reproduction steps or a minimal proof of concept
- the expected and observed behavior
- your assessment of impact

Do not include live credentials, tokens, customer data, or other secrets. If sensitive supporting material is required, ask the maintainers for a secure transfer method first.

Gazebo aims to acknowledge reports within 48 hours and resolve confirmed vulnerabilities within 14 days. Please allow time for investigation and remediation before public disclosure.

The full disclosure policy is available at https://gazebohq.com/docs/security/disclosure.

## Supported versions

AIP v0.1 is a published draft. Security fixes are applied to the latest source on the main branch. Once registry packages are released, this section will list supported release lines explicitly.
